heroHeadline: Al-Sharaa Invited to Historic G7 Summit; IDF Strikes Latakia Anti-Ship Missile Depots
heroSubtitle: Syria's transitional President Ahmad al-Sharaa will attend the June 15–17 G7 Summit in Évian-les-Bains — Syria's first-ever G7 participation — framed around Syria's bid to become a Middle East transit corridor amid the 2026 Strait of Hormuz crisis. The IDF struck anti-ship missile storage facilities near Latakia and Tartus on May 30, killing one civilian, continuing its campaign to degrade Syrian military capability 541 days after Assad's fall. Tom Barrack's US envoy mandate was expanded to cover Iraq and Syria (May 31); the UN formally ended its 11-year Turkey-Syria cross-border aid route as WFP emergency assistance cuts take effect. Syria's first post-Assad parliament is set to convene in June following the May 24 northeast elections completing the legislative chamber.
